description: This file contains the implementation of the PdfDictionary class and related classes for handling PDF dictionary objects within the PDFsharp library. It includes methods for creating, cloning, and manipulating PDF dictionaries and streams, as well as accessing and setting various types of PDF data elements. The code supports reading, writing, and deep-copying PDF dictionary structures, and provides mechanisms for handling nested objects, references, and filters.

classes.name: PdfDictionary
classes.description: Represents a PDF dictionary object, providing methods for manipulating PDF dictionary entries, streams, and cloning functionality.

classes.name: PdfDictionary.DictionaryElements
classes.description: Implements a thread-safe collection of key-value pairs representing the elements of a PDF dictionary, with methods for type-safe access and modification.

classes.name: PdfDictionary.PdfStream
classes.description: Represents a PDF stream associated with a dictionary, supporting cloning, value access, and unfiltering operations.

methods.name: PdfDictionary.Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the dictionary object, including its elements and associated stream.

methods.name: PdfDictionary.CreateStream
methods.description: Creates a new PDF stream with specified byte content and associates it with the dictionary.

methods.name: PdfDictionary.CreateDictionary
methods.description: Dynamically creates a new PDF dictionary of a specified type, optionally based on an existing dictionary.

methods.name: PdfDictionary.GetObject
methods.description: Retrieves the object associated with a specified key, dereferencing if necessary.

methods.name: TryUncompress
methods.description: Attempts to uncompress the stream data if a filter is specified, handling only certain compression algorithms like FlateDecode and LzwDecode, and removes the filter attributes upon success.

methods.name: IsFiltered
methods.description: Checks whether the stream has a '/Filter' key, indicating it is compressed or filtered.

methods.name: Zip
methods.description: Compresses the stream with the FlateDecode filter if no filter is already applied, updating the dictionary entries accordingly.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the stream content, decoding based on current filters if present.
